description: Source file implementing media type handling and decoder creation functions for Windows platform, including conversions between time units, media type enumeration, filtering, and AV1 decoder support checks.

methods.name: ConvertUsecToWin32Time
methods.description: Converts microseconds to 100-nanosecond units used in Win32 time.

methods.name: ConvertWin32TimeToUsec
methods.description: Converts Win32 time units (100ns) back to microseconds.

methods.name: GetAllOutputMediaTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all available output media types from a decoder for a given stream ID.

methods.name: GetAllInputMediaTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all available input media types from a transform for a given stream ID.

methods.name: FilterMediaBySubType
methods.description: Filters a list of media types by a specific subtype GUID.

methods.name: CreateAV1Decoder
methods.description: Creates an AV1 decoder instance if available.

methods.name: CreateDecoderTransform
methods.description: Creates a decoder transform instance based on a decoder GUID, with special handling for AV1.

methods.name: IsHardwareAv1DecoderSupported
methods.description: Checks if hardware-accelerated AV1 decoding is supported on the system.
